purpose: The supervisor self-restart fix passes the repository's Linux CI as well as Windows, and a deploy can never run with the restart triggers still live.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign repairs the independently verified R2-KEEPER commit 824d27e386dc (PR #40), whose new keeper test fails GitHub CI on Linux (#42), and closes the deploy.ps1 gap its verifier reported. It supersedes PR #40. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.
Read GitHub with REST only (gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/issues/<n> --jq .body, gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/pulls/<n>), never gh issue view or gh pr view.

Repository CI runs npm ci and npm run check on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/check.yml). Every test you add or change must pass there as well as on Windows: guard platform-specific behaviour with a skip that names the reason, or use the platform's equivalent, without weakening what the test checks on Windows.

tasks.title: Make the verified self-restart fix pass Linux CI and stop deploy on a failed task disable
tasks.outcome: The self-restart fix keeps every Windows check, passes the Linux CI run, and a deploy stops instead of continuing with live restart triggers.
tasks.goal: PR #40 (branch campaign/aw-reliability/R2-KEEPER) carries R2-KEEPER, independently verified at 824d27e386dc9e11af5fa4c6787b9e8bd3bb7452, but GitHub CI on ubuntu-latest fails: "not ok 177 - keep logs a console signal and its exit code before it ends, naming the serve child still running ... expected: NaN, actual: 128" (SIGBREAK exists only on Windows). Read #42 and #18 with gh api. In your worktree (current main): git fetch origin campaign/aw-reliability/R2-KEEPER, then git merge --no-ff 824d27e386dc9e11af5fa4c6787b9e8bd3bb7452. Then (1) fix tests/supervisor/keeper.test.mjs so every test is correct on Linux and Windows: SIGBREAK and any powershell.exe or Task Scheduler step runs only on Windows (skip with a reason elsewhere, or use SIGINT/SIGTERM where the behaviour under test is the same), and no Windows assertion gets weaker; check the rest of that file for other Windows-only assumptions. (2) In scripts/supervisor/deploy.ps1 stop the deploy, leaving STOP in place, when Disable-ScheduledTask fails for any reason other than the task not existing (today -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue lets it continue with live 5-minute triggers). Update docs/SUPERVISOR.md if the deploy order text changes. Run npm run check; in the PR say it supersedes #40 and list each changed test and why it still checks the same behaviour on Windows.
constraints: Keep 824d27e386dc9e11af5fa4c6787b9e8bd3bb7452 as an ancestor of your commit. Change only tests/supervisor/keeper.test.mjs, tests/supervisor/fixtures/keep-preload.mjs, scripts/supervisor/deploy.ps1 and docs/SUPERVISOR.md beyond the merge.
acceptance: HEAD contains 824d27e386dc9e11af5fa4c6787b9e8bd3bb7452 as an ancestor and its merge with main has no unresolved conflict.

Every test in keeper.test.mjs either passes or skips with a stated platform reason on Linux, and passes on Windows; the verifier checks the Linux behaviour by reading the guards and, where possible, by running node --test with the platform branch forced (the PR names how).
No assertion that ran on Windows before is removed or weakened (the PR shows the diff of each changed test).
deploy.ps1 stops with a clear message and leaves STOP in place when disabling a task fails for a reason other than a missing task (reasoned in the PR with the exact order of operations).
npm run check passes on Windows with exact tallies copied from the output.
